create_data_dataset: create a Data dataset from a pickle file with a given scale for Chinese handwriting recognition
build_merge_collate_fn: build a MergeFn collate function that combines batched handwriting samples into sparse convnet input tensors
get_train_val_iterators: get train and validation DataLoader iterators for Chinese handwriting dataset with automatic collation
run_data_interpolation: run interp to resample stroke coordinates and delta features onto a uniform arc-length grid
download_preprocess_data: download and preprocess OLHWDB1.1 Chinese handwriting dataset from feature_pot zip archives
